summary: Validate distributed QSA capacity and query metadata before launching kernels
compatibility: DCP plans must reserve at least one complete compressed group on each rank. Valid serving configurations are unchanged.
details: Reject an empty planned local score domain before workspace preparation can divide by zero; live requests may still have no local groups.
Check query positions and destination row capacity before global selection expansion writes to caller-owned scratch.
Reject non-DCP draft-selection reuse before returning an unwritten log-sum-exp buffer.
